Building #AI agents for network ops takes more than hooking an #LLM up to an #API. 

Sif Baksh’s book covers #NetOps workflows with #Python, #Ollama and #MCP, and Chapter 9 on production readiness (security, governance, observability, human approval) is excellent. 

Relevant for #AgenticAI in #DNS, #DHCP and #IPAM: https://sifbaksh.com/book/
